name: Cutix Plc
source: CRON 2026-10-07: audited group five-year financial summary, printed page 81 of _ngx_pdf/CUTIX.pdf, for the years ended 30 April 2025 back to 30 April 2021, in NGN thousands. The stored EPS cells for FY2024 back were computed on the post bonus issue share count: the printed basic earnings per share are 30.24, 22.43, 22.32 and 30.83 kobo for FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021, so as naira they are 0.3024, 0.2243, 0.2232 and 0.3083. FY2025 already matches at 14.65 kobo. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000); EPS in naira, printed kobo / 100.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFormula: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.source: CUTIX Plc audited consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 April 2025, group column, printed page 41 (file _ngx_pdf/CUTIX.pdf page index 40). The statement prints a single Finance Cost line with no finance income line, so Net Finance Costs equals that charge.

rows.label: EPS
rows.formula: Net Profit / shares outstanding (7045288104 shares, issued share capital (per the company's annual report))

derivation.ratios: recomputed for this file after the CRON 2026-10-07 statement corrections

_cron_derivation_20260930_092656: 2 cells filled from the file's own printed rows on 20260930_092656; every identity was confirmed on at least one other period of the same file with zero contradictions
source_note: Q1 FY2027 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47857_CUTIX_PLC.-_QUARTER_1_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2027_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_AUGUST_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column. MAGNITUDE: a period figure that was less than 5 percent of the prior annual column was withheld as unit-suspect; it is blank rather than rescaled.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
